runners.comment: Useful at two and three for R Hannon but 2025 was a struggle; sold 20,000gns since latest
runners.spotlight: The winner of just one of his 16 starts for Richard Hannon but he was often highly tried; unplaced in six runs in 2025 but that resulted in his handicap mark dropping 17lb; sold for 24,000gns in October; one of two making their debut for Tim Easterby.

quotes.race: Get A Run For Your Money At BetVictor Maiden Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)
quotes.quote: Pat (Dobbs) was confident about the trip for Son, although the ground was an unknown. Royal Ascot is a standing joke when you have a horse run well leading up to it and we'll discuss it. Either way we've got a nice horse - Julie Wood, owner.

stable_tour.quote: He ran on well and showed a bit of guts to finish fourth in the Greenham, which I was pleased with. He looked like he could have cried enough and finished six or seventh, but he stuck his neck out. We've taken him out of the Guineas and we're going to find something a little bit smaller for him. 29-04-24

runners.owner: Ian O'Connor & The Fox And Hounds

prev_owners.owner: Ian O'Connor & The Fox And Hounds

runners.comment: Promising 4th at Doncaster on his return but he needs to take a step forward to win here
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back wins at Ffos Las and Galway in June/July proved the highlight of his 2025 campaign; promising seasonal return when fourth of 16 at Doncaster three weeks ago; needs to take a step forward.

quotes.race: Clayton Hotel Galway Handicap
quotes.quote: It is soft Flat ground and It'sneverjustone loved it. He is a fine, big, strong horse and won nicely. I hope he is in again during the week! I've had two rides for David and two winners. He is an up-and-coming young trainer, so it's good - Declan McDonogh, jockey.

stable_tour.quote: He's a half-brother to Aberama Gold and El Hombre, who have won 20-odd races between them. He looks a pretty smart colt who I think will progress through the ranks each season. 30-05-24

runners.breeder: Haras De Saint Julien & Mme Regula Vanno

prev_owners.owner: Mohammed Bin Hamad Khalifa Al Attiyah
Haras De Saint Julien & Mme Regula Vannod

runners.comment: Best form for current stable has come on AW; best turf form on slower going
runners.spotlight: None too consistent for current stable and his best efforts in Britain have been on AW; ideally suited by testing ground when trained in France so rain would aid his cause.

prev_owners.owner: A Bintouq, C Fahy & R & S Marchant

runners.comment: Two handicap wins for R Varian last year; sold 34,000gns since latest; betting to guide
runners.spotlight: Won two handicaps for Roger Varian last year (7f, AW and 6f, soft); only fourth off this mark when last seen in October; sold for 34,000gns later that month; market to guide after his break.

runners.owner: A Pot To Pete In Syndicate
runners.comment: Had a good spell on AW this year but latest Doncaster fifth needs bettering
runners.spotlight: Arrives in good form, winning twice at Southwell in February and finding only another thriving rival too strong in his hat-trick bid last month; only fifth of 16 back on turf at Doncaster three weeks ago (behind It'sneverjustone); perhaps too high in the weights for now.

runners.breeder: G H S Bloodstock & J C Bloodstock
runners.owner: Future Champions Racing Syn & Ben Haslam
runners.comment: No impact in 3 runs for new connections; on a winning mark but only of interest if backed
runners.spotlight: Two 7f wins for Mick Appleby last summer; back to his last winning mark but that is a result of showing little in three starts for current connections; only of interest if attracting support.

quotes.race: Chapel Down Handicap
quotes.quote: War Howl is a nice big horse and hopefully he'll keep progressing. I thought he'd come on a lot from Doncaster, we were quite confident he'd do the job again. He's settled in quite well and is easy to deal with, and in his races he just does as much as he needs to. We'll have a sit down after today and see where we'll aim for next - Mick Appleby, trainer.

runners.comment: Did well last summer when cheekpieces were added; drop in trip not sure to suit
runners.spotlight: Did well once cheekpieces were added last summer, winning at Ffos Las (1m, good to soft) and in the frame on four other occasions; can get it wrong at the start and that may be an issue dropping back to 7f.

quotes.race: Join The Listowel Races Supporters Club (C & G) Maiden
quotes.quote: We got racing early. Henry said Narmar is a real galloper and the strong pace really suited. He handles nice ground and wants all of the mile trip on nice ground when there is no gallop. He parked when he got there so cheekpieces might help him. He's a nice horse going forward - Gary Carroll, jockey

runners.comment: Never dangerous at Doncaster on his reappearance; good mark if that run has brought him on
runners.spotlight: Now 9lb lower than for his Doncaster win last March (7f, good); never dangerous in the same race three weeks ago but that run should have sharpened him up; better expected today.

runners.comment: Well held on seasonal return but that hardly tells the tale; betting instructive
runners.spotlight: Began 2025 in good form, winning a handicap at Catterick and then finishing a good second at Ripon (both 6f, good); modest form in two runs back with Seb Spencer but his return to action at Doncaster three weeks ago certainly didn't get to the bottom of him, travelling well under restraint and then meeting some trouble as the race was unfolding; capable of better, perhaps markedly so, and the betting should be revealing.

stable_tour.quote: He's on an upward trajectory and we think he's still unexposed. He wants 7f - if it got very soft you could drop him back to 6f - and he won't mind a bit of juice in the ground. There are plenty of races for him coming into the last third of the season. 07-08-25

runners.comment: Not on a bad mark but Sunday's stable debut was a low-key one
runners.spotlight: Not on a bad mark but her low-key stable debut at Musselburgh on Sunday doesn't suggest she is the answer this time.

stable_tour.quote: She won at Newbury last August and I think she's getting herself ready to win again soon. She ran a really nice race last time under William Buick at Newbury when fifth behind American State. 02-07-25

racecards.verdict: A market move for Green Pursuit would be of interest but MUDAMER looks the safer option in a trappy race.
racecards.betting_forecast: 5/1 It'sneverjustone, 6/1 Mudamer, 8/1 Warm Spell,  Kosometsuke,  Packetofbiscuits,  Stanage, 10/1 Brighton Boy,  Son,  Narmar,  Green Pursuit, 12/1 Society Man, 16/1 Geo, 25/1 War Howl

racecards.race_name: Happy 21st Birthday Lily Watkinson Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: In good form until last at Newmarket in October; since gelded and without usual headgear
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Newmarket (1m4f) last April and in good form in handicaps after until coming in last of 12 back at Newmarket (1m4f) in October; since gelded and goes without usual headgear on his return.

quotes.race: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
quotes.quote: Minhad was a bit free at Haydock last time but David Egan got him settled this time and he finished off well. We were worried about the ground as ideally he wants it soft. He's in the Italian Derby but that will come too soon for him - Jose Santos, assistant to winning trainer Ismael Mohammed.

runners.comment: Has failed to fire for Ivan Furtado, only sixth at Newcastle latest; back over longer trip
runners.spotlight: Ended her time with Ralph Beckett with 1m2f Redcar novice success but she has failed to fire subsequently for Ivan Furtado, only sixth of eight in 1m Newcastle handicap last time; tried back over a much longer trip now.

runners.comment: In winning form over hurdles for current stable so not out of things on his handicap debut
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m4f scorer for Tom Clover who has been in good (winning) form sent hurdling for his current stable this winter, third at Ascot 20 days ago; not out of things on his handicap debut back in this sphere.

quotes.race: Sunshine On Leith Maiden Hurdle (Go North Night Nurse Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: I'm delighted with that. It wasn't expected as we were coming here thinking one was going to be very hard to beat. I wanted to get another run into Gallivanted on decent-ish ground. The key was his jumping, he jumped fine at Ludlow but just wasn't fluent. He was much quicker there and got the run of the race. I'm so pleased for his owners. He'll be a progressive horse through the spring, the ground is still not dry enough for him. There's a juvenile handicap at Ascot in April which could be right up his street. There's another one at Kelso on Morebattle [Hurdle] day, and as he likes the northern air we could come back - Harry Derham, trainer, speaking on Racing TV.

runners.comment: Solid fourth at Nottingham final run; still low mileage and could have more to offer
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start in handicaps at Catterick (1m4f) in October and not discredited off a 6lb higher mark given he went keenly when fourth at Nottingham (1m6f) in final run; this son of Waldgeist could have more to offer in 2026.

runners.owner: David Kilburn, Mrs Corbett, Chris Wright
runners.comment: Very good second at Catterick in October; yard going very well so she's a likely player
runners.spotlight: A dual 1m2f scorer in 2025 and she signed off with an excellent second in 1m4f Catterick handicap in October; yard continues to go very well so she's a likely player returning off the same mark here.

runners.comment: Remains winless but he comes here in good nick; needs considering eased 1lb
runners.spotlight: Remains winless but he comes here in good nick, second of six in 2m Southwell handicap last month; effective at this shorter trip and needs considering eased 1lb.

stable_tour.quote: He missed most of his two-year-old season as he was a very late foal. He has a pedigree that is very close to us, being by Sea The Stars out of Snow Fairy. He did little wrong at Chelmsford last time and it was annoying to get beaten a short head. I'm not totally convinced he's a 1m6f horse but it was a valuable race on the all-weather we thought we should go for. He's still a maiden, so we have that option as well. I think we'll probably go back to 1m4f on the turf. He ran over that trip once on turf as an inexperienced horse on very soft ground at Newmarket last year and hated it, so we'll look for decent ground. The handicapper has put him up to 80 and I'd hope he can improve on that. He's very much been a slow burner. 30-04-25

runners.breeder: Al Rabban Racing/Lope De Vega Syndicate
runners.comment: C&D scorer; beat just two in Musselburgh handicap last time though so needs to bounce back
runners.spotlight: C&D scorer who got back to winning ways at Wolverhampton (1m4f) in March; beat just two in 1m4f Musselburgh handicap last time though so needs to bounce back.

quotes.race: AJA Novice Flat Amateur Jockeys' Handicap (For Riders With 3 Wins Or Fewer At Start Of Season)
quotes.quote: I don't think what's happened has kicked in quite yet. I got a slow break away, but Made All travelled really nicely and sort of settled me down in a way. Then I waited and waited - Rebecca Hitchen, jockey, speaking to Racing TV.

stable_tour.quote: He's another legend who loves his work; the more you give him the better. His winning form coincided with fitting a tongue-strap, but also figuring out you have to ride him cold. When he's been ridden a bit closer to the pace, he doesn't necessarily finish. He's risen 20lb in the handicap this year but was unlucky three runs ago at Catterick, where he bumped into an improving three-year-old. 29-10-25

runners.comment: Failed to stay when fifth over 2m at Lingfield latest; not out of things over shorter trip
runners.spotlight: Looked on the up when gaining a breakthrough victory at Chelmsford (1m5f) in January; hasn't matched that form both runs since but he failed to last home when fifth in 2m Lingfield handicap last time; not out of things in a change of headgear over this shorter trip.

runners.comment: Solid Yarmouth fifth final run for Ed Walker; not discounted on stable debut
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start in handicaps at Windsor (11.5f) in September and backed it up with a solid fifth at Yarmouth (11.5f) the following month on his final run for Ed Walker; since changed hands for 32,000gns and he can't be discounted starting out for another good yard here with few miles still on the clock.

runners.comment: C&D winner but she ended 2025 under something of a cloud; needs to hit the ground running
runners.spotlight: A two-time scorer, including over C&D in the first half of 2025 but she ended last year under something of a cloud; needs to hit the ground running on her seasonal return.

runners.comment: Cosily landed 1m3f Southwell handicap 16 days ago; up 2lb but not taken lightly
runners.spotlight: Built on earlier promise (in a change of headgear) when cosily landing 1m3f Southwell handicap 16 days ago; up 2lb but not taken lightly.

quotes.race: Enterprising Women Eileen & Jean Nursery Handicap
quotes.quote: Hackney Diamonds broke smartly and the tailwind behind us took me through the last furlong. I felt like I was on fumes but she was tough and managed to fend them off - Billy Loughnane, jockey, talking to Racing TV.

prev_owners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with 1m4f wins at Musselburgh and Hamilton; up 5lb for can make presence felt
runners.spotlight: Revitalised in blinkers and ended 2025 with 1m4f handicap victories at Musselburgh and Hamilton in September; up 5lb for his reappearance but yard is in good form and can make his presence felt.

quotes.race: Musselburgh Racecourse Premium Annual Membership Handicap
quotes.quote: Cougar seemed to enjoy himself out in front. He's got ability. If you look way back in his form he was a decent horse. He lost his way a wee bit, but he's a decent hurdler as well. He's won and that's the main thing - Iain Jardine, trainer, speaking to Racing TV.

quotes.race: Value Cabs 3-Y-O Hurdle
quotes.quote: I thought Cougar was very keen which wouldn't be like him. He jumped great and it's great to have a horse like him in the yard. He doesn't mind these  conditions and it is great that he won, I'm delighted to have him. Mark said he jumped well and he is improving all the time. He is a horse to look forward to - Paudie Roche, trainer

quotes.race: gowranpark.ie 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Cougar is an exciting horse to get. When he got going Mark said he really got the hang of it. It was a lovely introduction - Padraig Roche, trainer.

racecards.verdict: It could pay to side with NIGHTSINWHITESATIN (nap) given she ended 2025 on the up and hails from a yard firing in the winners
racecards.betting_forecast: 4/1 Don Simon, 9/2 Nightsinwhitesatin, 5/1 Hackney Diamonds, 6/1 Cougar, 8/1 Gallivanted,  Lightning Tiger, 9/1 Relocal, 14/1 Minhad,  Furhaan, 20/1 Idyllic, 25/1 Made All, 33/1 Helmsley

racecards.race_name: Stirrup Bar For Deli-Style Dining Packages Handicap

runners.comment: Return to handicap company in his favour but he looks to face a tough task off top weight
runners.spotlight: Doncaster novice winner (5f, good to soft) last July and ran well for second in a soft-ground nursery at Sandown one month later; highly tried since and he has come up short, albeit running a good race when fifth in the Group 2 Flying Childers; drops back into a handicap but he has to concede weight to some promising sprinters.

runners.comment: Two nursery wins for the Crisfords, including C&D; not ruled out starting out for new yard
runners.spotlight: Won two of her four nursery runs for the Crisfords, including over C&D in September (good ground); improvement necessary to overcome this mark but she can't be ruled out on her first run for Robert Cowell.

runners.comment: Peak 2yo effort came on his only attempt at 5f; this should be run to suit; interesting
runners.spotlight: Raced over 5f only once as a 2yo but it produced his best performance, coming from rear to win a York nursery in October; 5lb higher today but this is set to be strongly run and coming from off the pace might be beneficial; interesting.

runners.comment: Two turf wins last year, including C&D; disappointed on seasonal/handicap/AW debut
runners.spotlight: Two wins as a 2yo, including C&D; slightly disappointing on her seasonal and handicap debut at Wolverhampton last month but it's possible the return to turf will see her in a better light.

quotes.race: Bob Vickery Memorial Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
quotes.quote: Daneh Of Dandy is a nice filly. Things just didn't go her way in the Group 3 at Ascot last time out. Maybe it was a little bit soon for her and maybe five furlongs is more her bag based on that, she looked quite quick didn't she? The St Hugh's Stakes at Newbury is a possibility and failing that we could go even further north for the five-furlong Listed race at Ayr - James Tate, trainers.

runners.comment: Promising in small-field AW events; unexposed but this race is considerably tougher
runners.spotlight: He has form figures of 211 but in fields of four, five and three; his ceiling is not easy to establish but there is no doubt he is in much deeper on this turf and handicap debut.

runners.comment: Of interest on last season's two best efforts; returns from a break in a deep race
runners.spotlight: Of interest on his two best efforts last year, namely a 5f novice win and a good second in a nursery at the Ayr Gold Cup meeting; market useful back from a six-month break.

stable_tour.quote: He probably had a run too many going into Royal Ascot after that and we backed off him as he just weakened on me. He won at Ripon and we went for the Norfolk and had a good day out. The form is in the book and I'm sure he'll bounce back. He keeps growing and is quite a tall horse and we won't overrun him between now and the end of the season. There's a Listed race back at Ripon at the end of August that he might go for and there are nurseries at places like Ayr and Doncaster. We'll try to get him to win again and put him away. He'll be a nice horse for next year. 07-08-25

runners.comment: C&D win last August; excuses in stronger races twice after; not fully exposed; yard runs 3
runners.spotlight: Made all when beating The Lost Sock by a head over C&D last August; came up short in stronger races twice afterwards but there were mitigating factors; one of three runners for Kevin Ryan.

runners.comment: Last seen finishing a close 2nd at York's Ebor meeting (6f); up 3lb but far from exposed
runners.spotlight: Won a Beverley maiden (5f, good to firm) in July and went on from there to run a stormer in a 6f nursery at York's Ebor meeting, showing bright speed and headed only late on; that form is rock solid and he looks a key player despite a 3lb rise.

runners.comment: 6f win here in September; followed up at Wolverhampton (5f) last month; this is tougher
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with an easy 6f novice win here on good ground; game effort to win a 5f handicap at Wolverhampton on her return 18 days ago but she would be no banker to confirm the placings with The Lost Sock on 3lb worse terms.

quotes.race: British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Simplify jumped well, she knew her job, she was very straightforward. She's made the running the last two times and I had it quite easy in front. She lugged left but she didn't have much company, she's not the finished article - Hollie Doyle, jockey.

runners.comment: Beaten fav in 2 AW runs last month but latest 3rd was a decent effort; chance back on turf
runners.spotlight: 5f win at Catterick on final 2yo start; flopped when strong favourite at Kempton on seasonal/handicap debut last month (too free over 6f); better effort when third at Wolverhampton 18 days ago (5f), having to wait for a gap to appear but keeping on when in the clear; still has some potential back on turf.

runners.comment: Promising at two, running well in the Super Sprint when last seen; stable runs three here
runners.spotlight: Didn't have to improve to win a four-runner Musselburgh maiden last July (5f, good; at 1-6); creditable seventh in the Super Sprint at Newbury 18 days later; absent since; one of three runners for Kevin Ryan.

runners.comment: Speedy filly who did well as a 2yo; needs to up her game to take this after a layoff
runners.spotlight: Two 5f wins on fast turf last summer; finished second at Chester in her hat-trick bid in September and she is only 1lb higher today; stable also runs Go Vince Go who beat this filly at York when she was last seen.

runners.comment: Maiden winner for Andrew Balding; sold 27,000gns in October; looks on a tough mark
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner but unplaced in two nurseries for Andrew Balding; sold for 27,000gns in October; looks up against it on her stable debut.

runners.comment: Consistent rather than progressive for H Charlton; sold 30,000gns since latest; opposable
runners.spotlight: Seventh time lucky for Harry Charlton when narrowly landing a 5f novice at Redcar 214 days ago; sold for 30,000gns in October; makes his handicap, seasonal and stable debut in a competitive event.

racecards.verdict: There are numerous possibles but THE LOST SOCK may find this a more suitable test than the AW races he was beaten in last month.
racecards.betting_forecast: 9/2 Simplify,  The Lost Sock, 5/1 Mo Of Cairo, 8/1 Daneh Of Dandy,  Merlier, 12/1 Dazzling Haze,  Big Fun, 14/1 Star Material,  Rikki Tiki Tavi,  Hanney Girl, 16/1 Go Vince Go,  Schrodinger's Cat, 20/1 Exclamation,  Entailed

racecards.race_name: Hunt Cup Next Meeting Saturday 2nd May Handicap

runners.comment: In fine form on the AW this winter; very lightly raced on turf but player in hat-trick bid
runners.spotlight: In fine form on the AW this winter, landing back-to-back 6f handicaps at Wolverhampton and Southwell recently; very lightly raced on turf but still merits serious consideration in his hat-trick bid.

runners.comment: Back on song to land 5f Catterick h'cap ten days ago; this C&D scorer needs to back it up
runners.spotlight: Back on song to land 5f Catterick handicap ten days ago; this C&D scorer needs to back it up off a 3lb higher mark.

quotes.race: goracing.co.uk Future Stars Apprentice Classified Stakes
quotes.quote: Golden Prosperity is limited but that's four races he's won. He's worth more than a racehorse as he leads the two-year-olds at home every spring. I ride him every morning so he must be a quiet ride! - Tony Coyle, joint-trainer.

runners.owner: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing
runners.comment: A dual 6f scorer in 2025 but didn't prove easy to catch right; needs to hit ground running
runners.spotlight: A dual 6f scorer in 2025 but he also didn't prove the easiest to catch right; needs to hit the ground running after 165 days off.

quotes.race: Brittains Beverages British EBF Novice Stakes (Plus 10 Race)
quotes.quote: Hurstwood is very hardy and genuine. On his next run we're going to step him up to six furlongs and see how he gets on - David Armstrong, owner.

runners.comment: On a long losing sequence and beat one in 5f Newcastle handicap in February last time
runners.spotlight: On a long losing sequence and she was retried in cheekpieces when beating just one in 5f Newcastle handicap in February last time; others appeal more.

stable_tour.quote: She's one to watch out for. She's been sixth and fifth at Ripon on her last two runs - you have to keep her ticking over. She has a lovely, big stride on her at home. She wants really soft ground and then she'll win. She's a lovely horse and she's my trainer's pick. 21-05-25

runners.comment: Took this on return year ago for Declan Carroll; debut for Ruth Carr and could bounce back
runners.spotlight: Took this on his return 12 months ago for Declan Carroll but he ended last term largely below par; starts out for Ruth Carr here and no surprise to see him bounce back.

runners.comment: Last of five for new yard at Newcastle, so switch to h'caps needs to spark major progress
runners.spotlight: Cut little ice in a pair of 1m2f maidens in Ireland for Natalia Lupini and last of five for his new yard in 7f Newcastle novice in February; yard is going well but this switch to handicaps needs to spark major progress.

runners.comment: Scored at Hamilton last July but she ended 2025 with four below-par efforts
runners.spotlight: Scored at Hamilton (5f) last July but she ended 2025 with four below-par efforts; others are preferred on this occasion.

quotes.race: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
quotes.quote: That was a lot closer than I originally thought, but at least we can call Stormy Pearl a winner again, which is great. I couldn't see anything between them in the photo but if she had kept a little bit straighter she may have been a clear winner, but that's racing and it was great to see her run so well. She's a lovely filly who's usually consistent and seems to really like the place. We'll be back this season we hope, don't you worry about that! - David Thompson, trainer.

runners.comment: Won at Southwell latest; yet to show much in a handful of turf runs though
runners.spotlight: Had the headgear left off when back to winning ways in 6f Southwell handicap 53 days ago; he's yet to show much in a handful of turf runs though, so needs to back it up.

runners.comment: Running-on sixth in 5f Catterick h'cap latest; interesting for in-form yard now up to 6f
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage filly who was campaigned at 7f/1m until a running-on sixth of 12 in 5f Catterick handicap ten days ago; interesting for her in-form stable now back up to 6f.

runners.comment: Course winner; has gone well fresh though, so is no forlorn hope on his reappearance
runners.spotlight: Course winner but he ended last season with a poor effort in 7f Newcastle handicap; this veteran has gone well fresh though, so is no forlorn hope on his reappearance.

quotes.race: ABF The Soldiers' Charity Classified Stakes
quotes.quote: Langholm is a yard favourite and he loves it here. He's a very free-going horse but you can let him get into his stride and it takes a good one at this level to peg him back when he's got a good lead in front - Connor Beasley, jockey, speaking to Racing TV.

runners.comment: It's now 13 outings since her last win; this C&D winner needs to take a step forward
runners.spotlight: It's now 13 outings since her last win and she ended 2025 with a pair of below-par efforts in 6f Newcastle handicaps; this C&D winner needs to take a step forward despite a falling mark.

stable_tour.quote: She must be one of the fastest Cannock Chases there is around. She got her hat-trick up at Ripon last week and it's never easy to win three on the bounce. The ground was plenty tight enough there and it was just because she was in sugood form with herself that we got away with it. When Graham Lee won on her at Thirsk a couple of years ago, we thought she was going to be an 80-plus horse, but last year she underperformed all season. She was never right and we gave her a wind op over the winter. The way she was galloping, I thought she'd win first time up but she didn't. We then upped her to 7f and she ran a little bit better, but as soon as we put a bit of headgear on she was a different mare. She didn't cost a lot of money and she's paid for herself several times over. She's straightforward and easy to train, and there's more to come as on her old marks there's still a bit of wiggle room. She loves proper softground. 28-06-24

runners.comment: 0-22 and he beat two in 6f classified event at Wolverhampton last time; blinkers go on
runners.spotlight: 0-22 and he beat just two in 6f classified event at Wolverhampton last time; blinkers are now tried on this unreliable sort.

runners.comment: Back on track when second in 5f classified event at Newcastle latest; possibilities

runners.spotlight: Gained her breakthrough win in 5f classified event at Newcastle in January but she's failed to build on it, only seventh in similar event there last month; usual hood is retried now (last on for her win).

runners.comment: Flat winner was a runner-up over hurdles twice last year; not at best in last two starts
runners.spotlight: Flat winner ran some eventful races over hurdles last year (ran out, jumped erratically) but for all that posted some decent runner-up finishes; tailed off on handicap hurdle debut at Fairyhouse and not at his best back on Flat at Navan last time either; must concede penalty; others preferred.

runners.comment: Well beaten in four hurdle races and a point; behind Try Them and Manoir De Mirande latest
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in four hurdle runs plus a point-to-point; behind Try Them and Manoir De Mirande at Limerick last month so bundles of improvement needed.

runners.comment: Half-brother to Iknowwhereiamnow (RPR 121); best watched on debut
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to 2m/2m4f hurdle winner Iknowwhereiamnow; dam pulled up in points, half-sister to 2m-4m1f hurdle/chase winner Jacks Island and bumper/useful 2m-2m4f hurdle winner Good Thyne Tara; best watched on debut

runners.comment: Dam 2m3f hurdle winner but unlikely to make an immediate impact
runners.spotlight: Dam 2m3f hurdle winner, closely related to 2m hurdle winner Getting Ready, half-sister to useful winners Final Assault (2m-3m hurdle/chase) and Last Encounter (2m4f hurdle); unlikely to make an immediate impact.

runners.comment: Winless from six on Flat but best run came after an absence; makes stable/hurdling debut
runners.spotlight: Winless from six runs on the Flat for Dermot Weld; best of those efforts was when second of 21 at Leopardstown on handicap debut when favourite; that run came after an absence, so perhaps this is the time to catch him on hurdle/stable debut.

runners.breeder: E A R L Les Bordes De Mornay & M Gerard Hanquiez

runners.spotlight: No Risk At All gelding was purchased for 65,000euros as a 3yo; dam placed in French 2m2f hurdle, half-sister to winners Kopek Des Bordes (high-class bumper and 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase), Utopie Des Bordes (useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase) and Darling Des Bordes (useful 2m1f-2m6f hurdle/chase); interesting newcomer, but Ole Ole is stable first-string; declared for 5.30 at Ballinrobe on Friday.

runners.comment: Top-rated of the field has been runner-up in all three Irish starts; big chance
runners.spotlight: Top-rated of the field ran well in sole French hurdles start and has filled the runner-up spot in all three Irish runs; beaten just a head at Leopardstown in December (2m, yielding); towards the rear when falling three out in the Fred Winter at Cheltenham when 18-1; hooded and suited by the race conditions; big chance.

runners.comment: Always out the back in both maiden hurdles; may find his level in handicaps
runners.spotlight: Always out the back in maiden hurdles at Cork and Limerick; may find his level in handicaps.

runners.comment: Just 2.75l behind Manoir De Mirande last time; he's going the right way and in good hands
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred ran with credit on debut in an academy hurdle but was well-held when falling at the last at Haydock (2m, soft); just 2.75l behind Manoir De Mirande at Limerick last time (2m, soft); he's going the right way and in good hands.

runners.breeder: Mme Karine Perreau & M Louis Colson

runners.comment: Signs of ability on Flat in France but poor in two Irish runs inc' over hurdles
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability on the Flat in France last year without winning but has been poor in two Irish runs, including when 34l behind on hurdling debut at Limerick; best watched.

runners.spotlight: Slight promise in her 31l third of six in her Punchestown bumper debut in February (2m1f, soft); fair chunk of improvement needed here.

runners.spotlight: First reserve; some positives in a couple of her Flat runs last year; makes stable/hurdling debut now but others more likely.

runners.spotlight: Second reserve; tailed off on bumper debut at Punchestown; ruled out.

runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden but some good runs in defeat; back-to-back runner-up finishes in maiden hurdles at Roscommon and Ballinrobe last August on better ground; way below that at Downpatrick when last seen in September.

He was entered at Tipperary on Thursday but that was just coming a little bit quick, so we'll wait for Navan in a fortnight. He's going to be a lovely middle-distance type. quotes.race: Franciscan Well Rated Novice Hurdle
quotes.quote: Disco Dancer got a very canny ride from Danny, he dictated from the front, quickened at the right time and he got a couple of good jumps out of her over the last two - Gordon Elliott, trainer

quotes.race: Buy Tickets On www.corkracecourse.ie Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Disco Dancer had some good form and she ran into some good ones. She had been unlucky not to win one before now. She battled well and was tough and straightforward - Sam Ewing, jockey.

quotes.race: Bluegrass Horse Feeds Mares INH Flat Race
quotes.quote: Disco Dancer ran in a Listed bumper first time out. I rode that day and it was very deep ground. I walked the track today and it was nicer ground than in Navan, so I knew she had her chance. Gordon said to sit in the first four or five, so I did my best to do so and it worked out - Josh Halford, rider.

runners.comment: Dual winning hurdler; performances progressively worsened since second at Navan in Dec'
runners.spotlight: Dual winning hurdler, with the latest win coming at Downpatrick last June off 3lb lower (2m3f, yielding to soft); good second at Navan in September (2m, soft to heavy) but performances have become progressively worse since and beaten 30l at Naas last time (2m3f, heavy).

runners.comment: Clearly in good form after winning on Flat and positive hurdle runs too; big chance
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose sort added his fifth Flat win when comfortably winning a Curragh handicap earlier this month on soft to heavy; winner of a Naas maiden hurdle (2m, good to yielding) when trained by Paul Traynor and has been a runner-up in both starts over timber for this yard, including when best of the rest behind the decent Eachtotheirown at Thurles in January; big chance.

quotes.race: 1xBet.ie Emerald Cup Handicap (Premier Handicap)
quotes.quote: It's a wonderful pot to win and Fiver Friday got a lovely run down the inside and won snugly. She'll have plenty of options over the summer and we'll see her over jumps again, possibly at Punchestown - Gavin Cromwell, trainer.

quotes.race: TRM Speedxcell Multi Vitamin And Mineral Tonic Handicap
quotes.quote: Fiver Friday handled the course here from her maiden form  and for her to get her head in front in Ireland is brilliant. They went plenty hard early on and set it up for her - Paul Traynor, trainer.

runners.comment: Bolted up at Sligo before two tailed off finishes; break may have helped but hard to trust
runners.spotlight: Bolted up at Sligo on her second start for her current yard in August (2m5f, good) off 107; tailed off at Ballinrobe following that and same story at Punchestown when last seen in October; the break may have done her good but she's hard to trust.

runners.comment: Added second hurdles win at Galway last year; returned with cracking run on Flat latest
runners.spotlight: Decent record over hurdles, winning two and placing in two more out of eight runs; latest win came at Galway (2m1f, good) in July off 8lb lower when aided by a strong pace to help her settle; off since then before returning with a cracking run on the Flat at Leopardstown six days ago when running on well for second on good to yielding ground; key player.

quotes.race: Tote, #5,000 Guaranteed Jackpot Irish EBF Mares Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I had a nice position the whole way. Harry just said get her to relax and creep away. Cleopatra's Needle relaxed and I crept away, she was good at the line. I just thought I'd keep it simple, I got all the gaps and it worked - Patrick M O'Brien, jockey.

quotes.race: Frank Lynch & Co Chartered Certified Accountants Supporting Louth GAA Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: It was Cleopatra's Needle's first run in a handicap and Sean was very good on her. He put her to sleep and was the last one to get into it. She's not a bad filly and she likes jumping. She showed a bit early on on the Flat and she was unlucky not to win three in a row. Then things just went wrong with her, she's a hard mare to keep right - Harry Rogers, trainer.

quotes.race: Book Your Navan Summer BBQ Packages Handicap (Div I)
quotes.quote: Cleopatra's Needle worked very well last week but she always did work well and is a well-bred mare. She loves top of the ground and she's going jumping as she has schooled over hurdles. Robbie Power had her for a while, schooling her, and said she had plenty of scope - Harry Rogers, trainer.

runners.comment: Five-time Flat winner is 1-5 over hurdles; decent fifth on AW recently; place chance
runners.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner is 1-5 over hurdles courtesy of a Tipperary mares' maiden hurdle win in May last year (2m1f, good to yielding); never involved in two subsequent handicap hurdle outings later in the year; decent return from a break when fifth of 14 at Dundalk last month; place chance.

quotes.race: tipperaryraces.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Eastern Wind was getting the hang of it as she went on. She jumped slick over the last couple after being a bit close over the first few. She idled a bit to the line and she'll be a bit of fun during the summer. We'll mix away on the Flat and over hurdles and she goes on any ground - Tom McCourt, trainer.

quotes.race: Sign Up For The Coast To Curragh Charity Cycle August 27th Handicap
quotes.quote: Eastern Wind was very gutsy. James gave her a good ride. She has to be in front and she will battle away if she is - Tom McCourt, trainer.

runners.comment: Point winner has been well beaten in four starts under rules' inc' h'cap; still early days

runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner for Jessica Harrington on good/good to firm with latest win coming in July last year; tailed off finishes sandwich a 5.75l sixth of nine at Punchestown (2m, soft to heavy) in three runs for this yard.

runners.comment: Best form has come on good inc' sole win; questionable whether this ground is suitable
runners.spotlight: Best form has come on good ground, including her sole win at Listowel in June off 89 (2m); ran well off 1lb higher at Roscommon next time when third (2m, good); hasn't run to the same level in four runs since (three on softer conditions); questionable as to whether this ground will be good enough but she's capable at her best.

quotes.race: Southern Waste Management Mares Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: We had been handicapping and the Policy Makers get better over fences. I don't know if we will keep going over the summer, Patty O'Farrell will be a better mare over fences - Peter Maher, trainer.

runners.comment: Good third on debut but didn't reproduce that after; lacked jumping fluency on h'cap debut
runners.spotlight: Made a good impression when third at Fairyhouse first time (2m, soft to heavy); failed to reproduce that form at the same venue on her second start or at Punchestown subsequently in a first-time hood; lacked jumping fluency at Navan on handicap debut when a 10.5l sixth of 12; others preferred.

runners.spotlight: Flat maiden won a Killarney juvenile hurdle last year before a lesser run at Listowel; won a Limerick handicap on return last month; a player up 6lb with more to come.

quotes.race: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I'm delighted with Something Noble and we were noticing in his work recently that while he isn't the quickest horse, if you hold him up, he has a bit of a gear. I told Eoghan to ride his own race, he gave him a lovely confident ride for a 7lb claimer. He'll go over fences soon as he can utilise his 4yo allowance and is a lovely big type. He is a Flat-bred but doesn't look like one, and has now won two hurdle races - Ciaran Murphy, trainer.

quotes.race: Killarney Park Hotel 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle

He won't be one that we can rush as he is a big scopey lad but is a nice horse going forward - Ciaran Murphy, trainer, speaking to RacingTV.

runners.comment: Probably didn't stay 2m6f last time and can do better back to this trip so considered
runners.spotlight: Third in a Naas handicap in January over 2m3f; beaten when fell next time; probably didn't stay 2m6f last time and can do better back to this trip so considered even as stable second-string.

In fairness he was a still a bit keen today but jumped very well. He came there easily, was green when hitting the front, lugging out to the left. He's still a baby but has a bit of class - Finian Maguire, jockey, speaking to Racing TV.

runners.comment: Well beaten over hurdles and fences lately and has to return to best older form; blinkers
